fa178f69bd609.add: - **In Search of Freedom:** autobiography of **Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee**, a founder of the HRA.

y720bd659fee.add: - **The Indian Patriot** (Madras) published leading articles in favour of the Andhra movement and helped the Andhras' propaganda (printed key, not verified).

n7a75c409e6e.add: - **Desasevikalu:** a women's body within the Congress pledged to **non-violent reform and propaganda for Swaraj**.

g2fd56a52c2c3.add: - **Vavilala Gopalakrishnayya** (Sattenapalli): Gandhian leader linked with ***Andhra Pradesh Gandhiji*** (keys: its author; he was himself called the "Andhra Gandhi").

ybef63854596.add: - **Ryoti system:** indigo contract farming – the ryot took an advance and signed a contract to grow indigo on **his own land**; under **nij** the planter grew it on his own land with hired labour.

yd51ee19ad62.add: - **Why the princes were brought into the Federation:** their nominated bloc in the federal legislature was meant to **counter-balance the nationalist (anti-imperialist) forces**.

yb8bf74a739c.add: - **1956 Assembly:** AP began **unicameral**, with a Legislative Assembly of **301 members** (196 from Andhra, 105 from Telangana).

yf5411f70edf.add: - **Subhas Chandra Bose** regarded the **Karachi session (1931)** as the **pinnacle of Gandhi's popularity and prestige**.
